checkpoint_rule: Fixed final epoch for every arm; selection CE is diagnostic only. No evaluation-based tuning.
cohort: Signal dates with archived source captures, same outcome-independent stock pool in every arm; retain stock-level missing features. Five-session label embargo at each split boundary.
limitations: Retrospective revised source, sparse feature history, reused development evaluation, one training seed, bounded continuation rather than full convergence. No point-in-time or executable-profit claim. No live checkpoint promotion.
ranking: Median T low; modal path peak date in T+1..T+4, earliest tie; median high on that selected date. Rank sell/buy-1-cost. Evaluate actual high on that frozen date / actual T low-1-cost as an extrema scenario, not executable profit.
